metadata.scope: Launch systems, atmospheric ascent and insertion to a defined Earth parking orbit; excludes interplanetary transfer and landing.

units.position: m in launch physics helpers; use km in SPICE/ephemeris interfaces and convert at API boundary
units.angle: rad internally; deg in human-facing CSV values

atmosphere.interpolation: linear between adjacent tabulated altitude rows
atmosphere.limitation: Standard dry-air reference atmosphere, not real-time launch-day weather; no wind, humidity, clouds, local pressure deviations or upper-atmosphere space-weather coupling.

forces_to_model: atmospheric drag relative to rotating atmosphere
later_refinements: Earth rotation and launch-site inertial velocity
Earth J2 and additional geopotential terms
launch_model_recommendation.integrator_recommendation: Adaptive Runge-Kutta (e.g. RK45/DOP853) or validated fixed-step RK4 with convergence tests; choose step size from accuracy and performance tests.
launch_model_recommendation.important: A payload-to-orbit headline figure is not a complete flight trajectory. The stage masses, thrust histories, guidance law and vehicle aerodynamic data are not publicly specified in the sources for all vehicles.

coordinate_conventions.site_elevation: metres above stated/unknown vertical datum; verify datum for each pad
coordinate_conventions.launch_simulation_frame: Earth-centered inertial (ECI); define exact inertial frame and epoch convention in the game API
coordinate_conventions.conversion: Convert WGS84 geodetic site coordinates to Earth-fixed Cartesian coordinates, then rotate to ECI using Earth orientation/rotation and launch epoch. Do not label the geodetic coordinates as ICRF.

provenance_policy.blank_numeric_fields: Not located in the cited public source set; do not substitute guessed values.
provenance_policy.source_fields: Every canonical data row should retain source_id and source URL through source_registry.csv.
